faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the free website audit.

items.a: Yes. The full audit, scores, charts, PDF download and sharing are free, with no signup or credit card. Optional ads keep it free.

items.q: How accurate is a browser-based audit?
items.a: Everything we mark as “Measured” was observed directly in your browser during the run. Checks that need server-side data are clearly marked “Requires server/API analysis” instead of being guessed.

items.q: Which checks require a server or API?
items.a: Response security headers (HSTS, CSP header, X-Content-Type-Options), caching and compression headers, full-page load timing, Core Web Vitals, multi-page crawling, DNS/WHOIS and backlink data. The report lists exactly what could not be measured.

items.q: Do you store my reports or personal data?
items.a: Reports are stored locally in your browser so you can revisit them. We don't require an account and don't collect personal information. The audited URL is sent to the website being checked (and, as a fallback, to a CORS proxy) — see the Privacy Policy.

items.q: Can I download and share a report?
items.a: Yes — download a PDF, print a clean report layout, or copy a link to the report. Shared links open on the device where the audit was run, because reports stay in local storage.

seoCopy.h2a: What does the free website audit check?
seoCopy.p1: WebAudit Pro evaluates every page it can read across seven categories: on-page SEO (titles, meta descriptions, headings, canonicals, structured data), performance signals (resource counts, render-blocking scripts, image optimisation), accessibility (alt text, form labels, landmarks, heading order), security basics observable from the browser (HTTPS, mixed content, security meta tags), technical SEO (robots.txt, sitemap, redirects, URL structure, hreflang), content depth (word count, text-to-HTML ratio, readability) and social metadata (Open Graph, Twitter/X cards).
seoCopy.h2b: Why run an audit before every launch?
seoCopy.p2: A missing meta description, a broken heading hierarchy or an image without alt text rarely breaks a site — but together they cost rankings, conversions and accessibility compliance. Fixing issues before launch is orders of magnitude cheaper than patching them after users and crawlers have seen the page.
seoCopy.p3: Accuracy matters more than impressive-looking numbers. This tool runs in your browser, so it can only report what a browser can observe: the HTML it can fetch and the DOM it can parse. Anything requiring server-side access — response headers, crawling an entire domain, Core Web Vitals field data, backlink indexes — is labelled “Requires server/API analysis” rather than faked. Connect the API adapter described in the README to unlock those checks.
seoCopy.p4: WebAudit Pro is multilingual by design: switch language from any page and the whole interface, the report and the PDF follow — including right-to-left layouts for Arabic, Urdu and Persian.

limitations.title: What this audit could not measure
limitations.note: These checks need server-side or API access. We show gaps instead of inventing results.

items.security_headers: Response security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) require server-side access and were not verified.
items.core_web_vitals: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) need the PageSpeed Insights or CrUX API — connect the API adapter to measure them.
items.page_timing: Full page-load timing (DOMContentLoaded, load event of the audited page) is not observable from another origin; only this run's HTML fetch was timed.
items.caching: Caching and compression headers (Cache-Control, gzip/Brotli) require reading HTTP response headers server-side.
items.contrast: Colour-contrast ratios require rendering the live page with computed styles — not possible on fetched HTML alone.
items.crawling: This audit reads one page. Site-wide crawling, pagination and orphan-page analysis require a server-side crawler.
items.backlinks: Backlink, domain-authority and keyword-ranking data require third-party SEO APIs.
items.server: DNS, WHOIS, hosting and server-technology fingerprints are not observable from the browser.

about.title: About
about.description: Why WebAudit Pro exists: honest, accessible, multilingual website audits with transparent scoring and no signup.
about.p1: WebAudit Pro started from a simple frustration: most free “website checkers” show impressive numbers they cannot possibly know. A browser cannot read your server's security headers, and a single fetch is not a crawl — so we refuse to pretend otherwise.
about.p2: Every check in this tool carries a measurement badge: measured directly, estimated, or requires server/API analysis. The scoring engine never awards points for checks it could not run, and every report lists its own gaps.
about.p3: The product is free, multilingual (30 languages, including Maithili with full Devanagari support) and built as a static site — no accounts, no personal data, no backend to breach.

scoring.title: How scoring works
scoring.text: Every check has a weight and a status: pass earns full credit, warning earns half, fail earns none. Checks that could not be measured are excluded from the denominator and shown as “Not available” — they never add points. Category scores are confidence-adjusted when coverage is partial, so a category with unavailable checks cannot display a perfect 100, and a category with nothing measurable shows “Not available” instead of a fake number.
